ShareProof / a working proof of concept

A NARROW, INSPECTABLE CHECK

Check the bytes,
not the overlay.

  1. OCR suggests email and phone locations. You decide what to cover or keep.
  2. A new canvas applies solid opaque fills. It contains the visible image and covers, with no separate hidden editor layers.
  3. The exported PNG is stripped of unneeded ancillary chunks, reopened and decoded. Every pixel inside each selected cover must match its opaque fill.
  4. The review note records that PNG’s hash, dimensions and inspection results. It excludes the source filename, image and OCR text.

English OCR can miss details. Inspect names, addresses, identifiers and context yourself. This app does not redact PDFs or certify complete anonymization.
